cost: U units,B bytes,E table entries,L alternatives,P prefix alternatives,C generated prefix×suffix candidates,K=min(max_k,U). Prefix context construction copies O(K²) units. For each prefix p whose rest lookup does not supply suffixes, suffix contexts copy O(K_p²) units, K_p=min(max_k,remaining units). Total context copying is O(K²+sum_p K_p²), conservatively O((P+1)K²), with actual UTF-8 unit byte lengths multiplying copy work; per-prefix rest concatenation additionally totals O(PB). BTree lookup O(log E) comparisons, candidate sorting O(C log C); cuts/normalization add O(C(B+U)), partial lex scans matching forms. Evaluation span membership O(Pgold*Ppred). Memory O(E text+C(U+B)+sentence keys).

inverse: Consonant-checked nonempty admissible outputs cannot lose/invent unpointed letters after removing H. This does not hold as a blanket claim for empty form: fallback Cut(0) is returned even though spells rejects it. Context does not rerank lexp/rules.

Pieces plus written form determine cut strings under valid coordinates; pieces alone admit all forms with matching unit length. Candidate winners admit many count tables and context histories. save cannot recover fallback, lex/rest booleans, absent level versus default Pointed, or original TSV order.
limitations: Finite supplied-input checks only; no corpus, training, external annotator, GPU, throughput or semantic-understanding claim. Allocation exhaustion and malformed arbitrary model arithmetic are not exhaustively exercised. No useful numerical surrogate is implemented; future caps may only be 1/2/5/10% with a declared metric.
state: Nonempty well-formed gold words; unit sums/usize and u32 counts representable. Valid cuts sum to units and exclude zero-length Cut. H consumes0; leading cut moves previous vowels. Probability domain positive table totals, finite host factor>=0, finite K>=0 with total+K>0. Public malformed states can violate premises.
